subject_name: Aircraft Electrical equipment, Power generation and Distribution
specific_objectives: 15.1.5.2 Trainee will be able to explain ratio meter type temperature indicator.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list

practical: Review of schematic diagrams; Instructor supervision of diagram interpretation; Safety: No live electrical testing on board.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a temperature indicator?
How does a resistance change with temperature variation?
Can you name one type of temperature sensor used in aircraft?

development.content:
Principle of Ratio Meter operation
Bridge circuit configuration
Deflection mechanism explanation
Calibration and zero adjustment
Advantages over other systems

Thermoelectric thermometer principle
Seebeck effect explanation
Thermocouple junction types
Signal generation and measurement
Applications in aircraft systems

topics: Comparison of Ratio Meter and Thermoelectric systems
development.content:
Comparison of Ratio Meter and Thermoelectric systems
Maintenance requirements
Troubleshooting common faults
Operational limitations
Integration with aircraft warning systems

summary_questions: Explain how the ratio meter indicates temperature changes.
Describe the Seebeck effect in the context of thermoelectric thermometers.
List two advantages of the ratio meter system over direct resistance measurement.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note comparing the operating principles of the ratio meter system and thermocouple systems, highlighting their respective applications in aircraft power generation and distribution.

pft_rows.syllabus: Thermocouple principle, thermocouple materials and combinations. Types of thermocouples, Thermocouple harness assemblies. Cold junction temperature compensation
